description: This file defines an interface and implementation for managing user notifications in an iOS application, including requesting permissions and adding notification requests.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of NotificationCentering that interacts with UNUserNotificationCenter to manage notification permissions and requests.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current notification authorization status.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Requests user's authorization for notifications with specified options, asynchronously.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a notification request asynchronously, handling errors appropriately.
